name: São Miguel do Iguaçu (Brazil)
description: Quartered green at the hoist and yellow at the fly by an off-centred white cross, charged at its intersection with a white disc bearing a blue eight-cogged wheel between wheat and soybean, over a red scroll reading 1961 SÃO MIGUEL DO IGUAÇU 1961.
history: São Miguel do Iguaçu is a municipality in the state of Paraná, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 16 November 1971 (prescribed with the arms by Municipal Law No. 22 of 16 November 1971, according to Flags of the World).

eight-cogged wheel between wheat and soybean, over a red scroll
